items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I notice you played with Jimmy Witherspoon... [INTERVIEWEE] Yup.

ctx.x: There’s things that could — but some of my best friends are drummers because I’ve been standing near them all my life. Well I’ve got to be a dummy to not understand — you spend a lot of time with drummers I think you’d better learn how to get along with them. I think that’s the way to go. Does that make — that makes sense?
It does indeed. Who were your — I notice you played with Jimmy Witherspoon and Billy Eckstine, more good singers, Chet Baker.
